description: The vimrc of the tracker's vi mode — the caller's own, or with 'projectKey' that project's, which lies over its members' own (order: vim's defaults, the person's vimrc, the project's vimrc, then ':set' on one device). Answers 'vimrc', 'warnings' (each {line, kind, word, message}: a line the editor will not read) and, for your own, 'ignoreProjectVimrc' (projects' vimrcs do not apply to you); for a project, 'canEdit'. Anybody who sees the project may read its vimrc. Read: 'set' with number (nu), hlsearch (hls), incsearch (is), ignorecase (ic), smartcase (scs), wrapscan (ws) and clipboard=unnamed|unnamedplus in vim's spellings (no…, inv…, !, &); 'syntax on|off'; 'let mapleader = ","'; and map, nmap, vmap, xmap, imap, noremap, nnoremap, vnoremap, xnoremap, inoremap of plain keys and <Esc> <CR> <BS> <Del> <Tab> <Space> <C-x> <leader> <Nop>. Comments (") and blank lines are fine. Any other line is not an error: it is kept, skipped by the editor and named in 'warnings' with its line.

projectKey.description: A project key, e.g. 'PM', for that project's vimrc. Left out: your own.
